about_pullquote: I started PC Decorating because I couldn't stand shoddy work. Every job matters.
about_para_1: PC Decorating Services was established 18 years ago in Hythe, Southampton, by a craftsman frustrated with the number of poor-quality decorating jobs he saw around the area. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local team known for meticulous preparation, colour advice, and finishes that last. We take pride in every project, whether a small bedroom refresh or a full commercial redecoration.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honesty, reliability, and respect for your home. We turn up on time, work cleanly, listen to what you want, and always leave a tidy site. Most of our work now comes from repeat customers and referrals—a testament to the standards we maintain. We're fully insured and pride ourselves on delivering results that transform your space without the stress.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our lounge completely redecorated—new wallpaper, paint, and woodwork. The team were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Colour advice was spot on. Really pleased with the result and would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Got a free quote the same day, and the lads turned up when promised. Interior painting quality is first-class. They moved furniture carefully and cleaned up every day. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: We've used PC Decorating three times now for different rooms. Always reliable, always professional, and they never cut corners. The exterior cladding work they did last year has held up brilliantly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.
